answer: Each agent joins as a vertex in a public referral graph, posting a 40-token bond and naming its inviter before earning. A nebula of new identities is normal, but peers audit: vertices sharing one inviter or identical timing get flagged for dispute. Proven forgery slashes both bonds. Forging 1,000 identities locks 40,000 tokens. An honest agent pays once, completes its 20-epoch voyage of work, and is refunded plus a share of slashed funds.
